questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · Accounting Paper 1 · Question 1.1

Which item appears on the Statement of Comprehensive Income?
questions.explanation: Sales is income and belongs on the Statement of Comprehensive Income.

questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · Accounting Paper 1 · Question 1.2

Which account is classified as a non-current asset?
questions.explanation: Vehicles used long-term are non-current (fixed) assets on the Statement of Financial Position.

questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · Accounting Paper 1 · Question 2.1

Name ONE reason why the bank statement balance may differ from the cash journals balance.
questions.explanation: Timing differences (e.g. outstanding deposits/cheques) or unrecorded bank charges cause reconciling items.
